headline: PSG scored four times in the first 17 minutes while Villarreal managed two blocked shots, and finished with 12 shots on target to 2.

team_story.label: Shots on target
team_story.why_it_matters: PSG hit the target six times as often; Villarreal's keeper faced 12 and made 6 saves.

team_story.label: Touches in opposition box
team_story.why_it_matters: Villarreal barely reached PSG's area; PSG lived in theirs.
team_story.source: data/research/scrape_3d82b9746589.json, 'Attack' section: 10 Touches In Opposition Box 43

team_story.label: xG
team_story.why_it_matters: PSG scored 6 from 2.69 xG; Villarreal never created a big chance (0 v 2).

team_story.label: First 17 minutes: shots
team_story.why_it_matters: PSG scored 4 from those 8 shots (5 on target); both Villarreal shots were blocked (0.07 xG).

tactical_change.after: 4-2-3-1 (three changes at 63', Oluwaseyi, Moleiro, Mikautadze on)
tactical_change.trigger: Down 0-4 at half-time, with Cardona on at 46'; no shape change reported. Biggest shift is half to half: Villarreal had 4 shots (0.16 xG) in the first half and 10 shots (0.51 xG) in the second, while PSG fell from 15 shots (1.72 xG) to 7 (0.98 xG) after the break.
tactical_change.effect: The second-half shift: PSG eased off (15 shots to 7), Villarreal's shot count more than doubled (4 to 10) but their on-target count stayed at 1 per half and PSG still scored twice (50', 78').
tactical_change.note: Formations in https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cm0ld2p49xx0t (data/research/scrape_9d6dd3db09ba.json, 'Team Lineups'): Villarreal 4-2-3-1, PSG 4-3-3. Substitution minutes from the same section. Half-time score is 4-0 per ESPN search snippet 'First Half ends, Villarreal 0, Paris Saint Germain 4' (data/research/search_cd61f7b69648.json). Not a real tactical change: use as context only.
